recipe.visualDefinition: A clean studio portrait of four men in contemporary western-influenced attire, set against a neutral light grey background. The composition is defined by a massive, bright yellow sans-serif title angled across the top and a classic, high-contrast serif band name anchored at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the oversized background text and the human subjects
Color pop of neon yellow against a muted, desaturated studio environment
Dynamic diagonal movement of the top text versus the stable horizontal base text
Textual layering where subjects stand in front of the large background letters
coreInvariants: Neutral, slightly textured light grey studio backdrop
Full-body standing poses with natural, relaxed posture
High-contrast black serif typography at the footer
Bright yellow sans-serif typography at the header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally in the middle ground, scaled to occupy the central 50% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom-centered band name in black provides a heavy visual weight to ground the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright yellow top-left, follows the diagonal text down to the subjects, and rests on the dark text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the subjects' heads and feet to allow for large-scale typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (browns, tans, and denim in clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for graphic elements, low saturation for the photographic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant blues or reds in the background
Maintain a desaturated skin tone and clothing palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and high-contrast transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Heavy weight, wide proportions, uniform stroke width
Bottom text: High stroke contrast, sharp serifs, ball terminals on specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Bottom text features a distinctive 'g' with a closed loop and a 'y' with a deep descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a modern, loud sans-serif and a traditional, elegant serif.

preserve: The diagonal tilt of the top text
The high-contrast serif style for the bottom text
avoid: Distressed or weathered textures on text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric sans-serif feel of the top text.
Provides the high-contrast serif look with elegant terminals for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of four men in modern western clothing (hats, flannels, jackets) standing in a row against a plain light grey wall. Leave significant empty space at the very top and very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large neon yellow uppercase sans-serif text tilted 15 degrees upwards behind the men's heads. Add a single line of black high-contrast serif text centered at the bottom, overlapping the men's feet.

verificationChecks: Is the top text neon yellow and tilted?
Are the subjects positioned between two distinct layers of text?
Is the bottom text a high-contrast serif font in black?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the band
Specific color of the background text (e.g., neon pink or orange)
mustRedesign: Unique ligatures in the serif font

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is behind the subjects' heads.
Check that the black text is in front of the subjects' feet.
Ensure the background is a neutral, non-distracting grey.
Verify the diagonal tilt is consistent across the top words.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Diagonal Neon Sans-Serif Header] + [Horizontal Black Serif Footer] + Neutral Backdrop
